Details Brand: AppleSize Description: Materials: Washing Instructions: Country of Origin: Other Details: DescriptionDetails Back Experience breathtaking sound quality with the world’s best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation. Built-in heart rate sensing lets you track your heart rate and calories burned during workouts. The improved Hearing Health support features automatic Conversation Boost to seamlessly amplify voices in front of you, and Live Translation helps you communicate across languages, enabled by Apple Intelligence.The internal architecture has been completely rebuilt for better acoustic performance and the external geometry redesigned for a more secure fit. With improved battery life, you can get up to 8 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation on a single charge.
